title: Speaking the Navigator's Language: Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translation for Frozen Aerial VLN Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.10635v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aerial vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents are typically trained on detail-rich, trajectory-aligned commands, whereas users issue short, intent-driven instructions; on a frozen OpenFly navigator, this \emph{instruction gap} drops success rate (SR) from $31.03\%$ to $11.33\%$. To scale translator training, we prompt a language model with human-written style examples to convert original commands into paired, intent-centered Weak commands, which yield $15.27\%$ SR. We introduce the \textbf{Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translator (TGIT)}, a front-end that keeps the navigator frozen and translates Weak inputs into agent-executable commands by learning from its trajectory outcomes. The resulting Weak-trained translator raises Weak-input SR to $37.93\%$ and transfers zero-shot to real human instructions ($11.33\%{\rightarrow}32.51\%$); it also improves held-out OpenFly ($4.95\%{\rightarrow}20.79\%$) and yields recovery on CityNav and

translated_title: 说导航器的语言：面向冻结航空视觉-语言导航智能体的基于轨迹的指令翻译
translated_abstract: 航空视觉-语言导航（VLN）智能体通常是在细节丰富、与轨迹对齐的指令上训练的，而用户发布的却是简短的、以意图驱动的指令；在一个冻结的OpenFly导航器上，这种“指令鸿沟”使成功率（SR）从31.03%降至11.33%。为了扩大翻译器的训练规模，我们利用人工撰写的风格示例提示语言模型，将原始指令转换为成对的、以意图为中心的弱指令，这些弱指令仅能获得15.27%的SR。我们提出了基于轨迹的指令翻译器（TGIT），这是一个保持导航器冻结的前端模块，通过从导航器的轨迹结果中学习，将弱输入翻译为智能体可执行的指令。由此用弱指令训练出的翻译器将弱输入SR提升至37.93%，并能零样本迁移到真实人类指令上（11.33%→32.51%）；它还在留出的OpenFly任务上有所提升（4.95%→20.79%），并在CityNav等任务上带来了性能恢复。
tldr: 提出了基于轨迹结果的指令翻译器TGIT，无需改动冻结的航空VLN导航器，即可将用户简短的意图式指令翻译为智能体可执行指令，将真实人类指令下的成功率从11.33%提升至32.51%并实现零样本泛化。
en_tdlr: We propose the Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translator (TGIT), which translates users' short intent-driven commands into agent-executable instructions for a frozen aerial VLN navigator by learning from trajectory outcomes, raising success rate from 11.33% to 32.51% on real human instructions with zero-shot generalization.
